published_variants: Upstream benchmark gives family and size, not exact checkpoint revision. Candidates are explicit.

models.implementation_note: Embedding/residual/logit scaling, LongRoPE and GGUF Q/K head layout implemented. Baseline recorded; tokenizer matches official tokenizer on 80 cases. SDK quality gate remains pending.

CPU and ordinary OpenCL decoder with FP32 matrix/shift state, shared first-layer values, LayerNorm/GroupNorm and squared-ReLU channel mixing implemented. CPU/Mali cache/reset/generation checks and 95 tokenizer cases pass. Prepared Mali body projections disabled after scheduling failures; generic one-token prompt fallback is explicit. Full checkpoint and 128/64 baseline are recorded; matched RKLLM quality/speed remains unqualified.

The GGUF converter already splits grouped QKV; added its required Llama-style Q/K RoPE inverse permutation. Full checkpoint and 128/64 baseline are recorded; matched RKLLM quality/speed remains unqualified.

Post-attention/FFN norms, GELU gating, embedding scaling, softcaps and alternating sliding attention implemented; independent CPU/reference checks pass. Full checkpoint and 128/64 baseline are recorded; matched RKLLM quality/speed remains unqualified.

Integrated language decoder passes independent CPU/GPU fixtures and full 128/64 OpenCL baseline. Three full warmups and three measured runs; deterministic measured output. Official tokenizer, full-model reference quality, matched RKLLM performance and image/audio/API qualification remain pending.

Original HF shards are checksum verified and converted to a 267-tensor FP16 GGUF; tensor-directory shapes and tokenizer metadata validated. Full-model inference, performance and RKLLM quality qualification pending. Short rotary range supported through 8192; extended dynamic NTK remains unsupported.
Fused QKV and fused gate/up GGUF projections now load into the decoder, with bitwise parameter/logit/cache checks. Full checkpoint baseline and larger-model memory checks remain pending.

Fused latent K/V, value-head width, rotary factors and model scales implemented. Independent CPU/OpenCL small-decoder checks pass; actual GGUF tensor-directory schema validates with NULL placeholders. Full-model inference and benchmark pending.

File-backed gate/up splitting, bounded source pages and sequential final layouts enable complete 128/64 GPU runs on the 16 GB board. CPU/GPU fixtures and 3+3 baseline pass. Full-model reference quality, matched RKLLM speed, and API qualification remain pending.
Text-only decoder baseline recorded using Q/K RMSNorm and ordinary RoPE (all three multimodal position axes coincide for text). Image encoder, connector and image-input performance are not qualified.

Text tokenizer matches 1044 official cases. Ordinary MHA full-head rotary correction and dense/MoE/shared-expert decoder pass independent CPU and Mali OpenCL prefill/cached-decode checks on a small model. Full-model baseline and quality qualification pending. Vision encoder/connector not included.

Memory-bounded Mali fused recurrent path measured at context512 with actual 128-token chunks and 3 warmups + 3 measured requests: 2735.69ms TTFT, 46.79 prefill proxy tok/s, 4.54 decode tok/s. All six 64-token sequences match the original baseline. Exact-hash worker policy enabled at context<=512 for realized GPU-only inference; generic app RAM admission remains conservative. RKLLM quality/speed and maximum-context qualification pending.

All six 64-token sequences match the original baseline. Exact-hash worker policy enabled at context<=512 for realized GPU-only inference; generic app RAM admission remains conservative. Generic loader, independent CPU/GPU numeric fixtures and full 128/64 OpenCL baseline pass. Three full warmups and three measured runs; deterministic measured output. Full-model reference quality, matched RKLLM performance and vision/audio/API remain unqualified.
Short-convolution and attention blocks implemented; CPU and Mali small-decoder checks pass. Full-model text baseline recorded; independent full-model output check pending. Vision encoder not ported.

Baseline recorded; independent streaming PyTorch decoder using pinned official config reproduces the first 4 greedy tokens of the full 1.7B model. Small CPU/Mali decoder checks and 92 tokenizer cases pass. Matched RKLLM W8A8 quality qualification remains pending.

Full FP16 OpenCL baseline measured with direct-weight GEMM and no persistent packed copy. First 4 greedy tokens match independent PyTorch equations using pinned official config. Prefill is very slow; no published RKLLM X2.6 reference or quality-qualified speed win.

phase: All original-table baselines complete; performance optimization and quality qualification pending.
